caption:
Global Metadata: A bright, joyful wordless hum, 116 BPM, G major, a sunny pastoral celebratory instrumental. Emotional arc: cheerful and warm from start to finish, sparkling morning meadow sunshine, light-footed gladness, ending on a warm uplifting note. Production: bright, clean, sunny, crisp, feel-good mix.

Vocal Details: A single voice only, an adult female soprano (or a light male vocal) humming wordlessly, a bright, lively, twinkling 'mm' and 'la', cheerful and buoyant, like humming while skipping on a sunny path. Playful and light, smiling.

Arrangement: Intro, a springy acoustic guitar and a cheerful flute line, sunny. Body, the bright hum dances over bouncy acoustic guitar, a light tambourine, and a cheerful fiddling string, festive and warm. Ending, the hum and strings land on a bright, resolved, happy close.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Springy guitar, flute, sunshine

[Body]
mm... la... mm... la...
aah... la... mm...

[End]
bright happy close
